purpose: Schema PRIOR for the dynamic-application runtime. Hints only. Fresh rendered DOM is authoritative. Nothing here is a selector contract or a script.

coverage.note: Singleton (Candela Medical, Taleo Business Edition careers v2). The job page has 0 forms; 'Apply Now' -> applyRequisition renders ONE document (form#TBE_theForm, 143 elements) containing all 6 steps; steps 2-6 are hidden until step 1 'Register' (email + new password) is completed. Registration creates an account, which is prohibited, so nothing was entered; but every step's blank questions/options were captured from the hidden DOM.

steps_visited: apply page step 1 'Register' (visible) + steps 2-6 (hidden in same DOM, read via extractor)

page_shape.single_page_form: one form#TBE_theForm (method post to .../voluntaryInfo) holding 6 stepped sections; progress cue '1 of 6'
page_shape.apply_entry: 'Apply Now' anchor on viewRequisition -> applyRequisition (same host)

control_families.registration: Email* (max 75) + Password* (max 30) + 'Re-type new password:*' — creates a Taleo candidate account (STOP: account creation prohibited).
control_families.text: input[type=text] with label[for] and matching aria-label; required flagged via required attr AND red asterisk.
control_families.native_select: State/Territory (71 incl. 'Outside of US or CANADA'), Country (185), Source (16, employer-specific incl. 'Other (Please Specify)'), Work Authorization (4), yes/no (3 with 'Please select'), month/year pickers.
control_families.checkbox_group: Overtime Availability CUSTOM_1098 [Weekdays, Weekends, Not Available] with hidden _total field.
control_families.date_picker: Date Available for Work (CUSTOM_1096) text + month/year selects.
control_families.textarea: custom questions CUSTOM_1100/1102/1103/1106; Work history Description.
control_families.file: attachment_template accept .gif,.rtf,.doc,.pdf,.zip,.docx,.csv,.txt,.gz,.xlsx,.xls,.ppt,.pptx (resume upload 'Save Time' + additional attachments; 10MB total).
control_families.repeaters: Work History (last 4 employers), Education History, Certificates and Licenses — each a group with Save/Cancel/Add.
control_families.esignature: Candidate eSignature* (text, max 100) + Candidate eSignature Date* on step 6 — attestation.

runtime_observations: All six steps exist in the DOM at once; hidden-step controls are readable for mapping but must not be treated as fillable until their step is active.
Required-ness is reliable here (required attribute + asterisk).
Custom question ids are CUSTOM_<n>; labels/aria-labels are the stable key.

inferred.login_variant_unverified: Existing-account login path (instead of Register) was not observed.

provider_hint.for_jev: taleo (TBE careers v2): six-step single-form document. Stop at step 1 Register (account creation). If the user is logged in, map by label/aria-label; classify: fact_copy (name/phone/address/links), option_choice (state/country/source/work authorization from verified facts), eligibility (18+, work authorization), free_text (previous employment at Candela, relatives, other names -> facts or 'N/A' only when verified), free_text_narrative (job-related skills summary -> writer), repeaters (work/education history from verified facts), attestation (eSignature/date -> human). Stop before 'Submit'.

requires_human_input: other names / relatives / prior application disclosures

edge_cases: The Source list contains recruiter names and German-language entries (employer-specific); do not normalise.
Date pickers use year lists starting at 1931; a naive 'first option' pick is wrong.
State list includes 'Outside of US or CANADA' as the second option.
